title: fix(anthropic): omit temperature for Claude 4.7 and later models

files.patch:
@@ -657,6 +657,20 @@ def __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any]):
             self.client = None
 
 
+# Claude 4.7 and later (Opus 4.7+, the 5.x families, Mythos Preview) answer 400 to
+# a non-default temperature/top_p/top_k, so the field has to be left out.
+_CLAUDE_FIXED_SAMPLING_RE = re.compile(
+    r"claude-(?:opus-4-(?:[7-9]|[1-9]\d)(?!\d)"
+    r"|(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-(?:[5-9]|[1-9]\d)(?!\d)"
+    r"|mythos-preview)",
+    re.IGNORECASE,
+)
+
+
+def _claude_rejects_temperature(model: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(model, str) and _CLAUDE_FIXED_SAMPLING_RE.search(model) is not None
+
+
 class AnthropicProvider(AIProvider):
     """Anthropic Claude API provider"""

+import json
+import sys
+import types
+
+import aiohttp
+import pytest
+
+from landppt.ai.base import AIMessage, MessageRole
+from landppt.ai.providers import AnthropicProvider
+
+REJECTING_MODELS = [
+    "claude-opus-4-7",
+    "claude-opus-4-7-20261015",
+    "claude-opus-4-10",
+    "claude-sonnet-5-5",
+    "claude-haiku-5-5",
+    "claude-fable-5-1",
+    "claude-mythos-preview",
+]
+ACCEPTING_MODELS = [
+    "claude-opus-4-6",
+    "claude-opus-4-1-20250805",
+    "claude-opus-4-20250514",
+    "claude-sonnet-4-6",
+    "claude-haiku-4-5",
+    "claude-3-5-haiku-latest",
+]
+MESSAGES = [AIMessage(role=MessageRole.USER, content="hello")]
+
+
+def _provider(model):
+    return AnthropicProvider(
+        {"api_key": "test-key", "base_url": "https://api.anthropic.com", "model": model}
+    )
+
+
+async def _messages_request(monkeypatch, model):
+    calls = []
+
+    class FakeMessages:
+        async def create(self, **kwargs):
+            calls.append(kwargs)
+            return types.SimpleNamespace(
+                model=kwargs["model"],
+                content=[types.SimpleNamespace(type="text", text="ok")],
+                stop_reason="end_turn",
+                usage=types.SimpleNamespace(input_tokens=1, output_tokens=1),
+            )
+
+    class FakeAsyncAnthropic:
+        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+            self.messages = FakeMessages()
+
+    monkeypatch.setitem(
+        sys.modules, "anthropic", types.SimpleNamespace(AsyncAnthropic=FakeAsyncAnthropic)
+    )
+    await _provider(model).chat_completion(
+        MESSAGES, tools=[{"name": "noop", "input_schema": {"type": "object"}}]
+    )
+    return calls[0]
+
+
+async def _stream_request(monkeypatch, model):
+    bodies = []
+
+    class FakeContent:
+        def __aiter__(self):
+            return self._iterate()
+
+        async def _iterate(self):
+            yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'message_stop'})}\n".encode()
+
+    class FakeResponse:
+        status = 200
+        content = FakeContent()
+
+        async def __aenter__(self):
+            return self
+
+        async def __aexit__(self, *exc):
+            return False
+
+    class FakeSession:
+        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+            pass
+
+        async def __aenter__(self):
+            return self
+
+        async def __aexit__(self, *exc):
+            return False
+
+        def post(self, url, headers=None, json=None):
+            bodies.append(json)
+            return FakeResponse()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(aiohttp, "ClientSession", FakeSession)
+    async for _ in _provider(model).stream_chat_completion(MESSAGES):
+        pass
+    return bodies[0]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model", REJECTING_MODELS)
+async def test_temperature_is_omitted_for_models_that_reject_it(monkeypatch, model):
+    assert "temperature" not in await _messages_request(monkeypatch, model)
+    assert "temperature" not in await _stream_request(monkeypatch, model)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model", ACCEPTING_MODELS)
+async def test_temperature_is_kept_for_older_models(monkeypatch, model):
+    assert (await _messages_request(monkeypatch, model))["temperature"] == 0.7
+    assert (await _stream_request(monkeypatch, model))["temperature"] == 0.7
